name: MCP Gateway
description: A production-grade platform that connects AI assistants to internal databases and filesystems through a single authenticated endpoint. It features role-based access control, SSO integration, and built-in tools for querying SQL databases and managing files with full audit logging.

rawRecord.description: A production-grade platform that connects AI assistants to internal databases and filesystems through a single authenticated endpoint. It features role-based access control, SSO integration, and built-in tools for querying SQL databases and managing files with full audit logging.

SECRET_KEY.description: JWT signing secret — use a random 64-char string

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated allowed origins for CORS. Must be absolute URLs — wildcards (*) are rejected

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL DSN — set automatically by docker-compose; only needed for local (non-Docker) dev

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Fernet AES key for DB credentials — minimum 32 characters; full key consumed via BLAKE2b

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password — used by docker-compose for both the db service and DATABASE_URL

FILESYSTEM_ALLOWED_DIRS.description: Comma-separated directories the MCP filesystem tools may access. When empty, no filesystem tools are exposed

OAUTH_STATE_TTL_MINUTES.description: OAuth PKCE state validity window — increase for high-latency SSO providers
